item.mchjong.point_interaction: Use on a table to place one stick. Sneak-use the top with empty hands to collect your side's stack.
item.mchjong.point_help: Physical counters do not change the game's scores.
item.mchjong.box_dye_help: Craft the box with one dye to recolor every tile back. Point sticks are preserved.
item.mchjong.manual_table_help: Manual handling, automatic rules and scoring.
item.mchjong.automatic_table_help: Automatic shuffling, wall building and dealing.
item.mchjong.equipment_help: Use a complete box or cloth to install it. Between matches, sneak with empty hands: top removes cloth, side removes box.
item.mchjong.box_help: Open to store tiles and sticks. Craft with an ink sac to engrave 136 matching blanks, or with one dye to recolor all tiles. Spare blanks are kept.
message.mchjong.equipment_locked: End the match before changing the table's cloth or box.
message.mchjong.incomplete_box: This table needs a complete, uniform 136-tile riichi set with three red fives.
ui.mchjong.equipment_needed: Install a complete mahjong box before starting.
ui.mchjong.result_help: Use tabs for hand details and standings; ←/→ selects a ron winner.
ui.mchjong.exit_hint: One human can end the table immediately. With multiple humans, everyone must agree. Unfinished hands are not scored.
ui.mchjong.exit_paused: Play and thinking time are paused. No reply means no agreement.
message.mchjong.exit_unavailable: An exit vote is active or a recent vote was rejected. Try again after 30 seconds.
ui.mchjong.open_hands_hint: The host chooses before play. All seated players see one another's hands; spectators do not. Changing this resets readiness.
settings.mchjong.river_hint: Hiding the rivers always keeps the remaining wall count visible. Game rules and replay records are unchanged.
replay.mchjong.title: Replays
replay.mchjong.export_failed: Export failed; check the game log.
replay.mchjong.controls: Left/right: step. Space: play or pause. Home/end: start or result. Scroll: inspect seats.
message.mchjong.replay_busy: A replay request was just processed. Please try again.
message.mchjong.replay_unavailable: Replay unavailable. Only participants can open their completed hands.
settings.mchjong.system_voice_note: System speech uses the local speech backend. Voices, languages and volume controls depend on the operating system. Minecraft's accessibility narrator is unchanged.
settings.mchjong.pack_voice_note: Voice recordings are supplied by a resource pack. Select Resource pack and install recordings for the mchjong:voice.* sound events.
settings.mchjong.voice_unavailable: System speech is unavailable on this device. Resource-pack recordings are supported separately.
ui.mchjong.invite_hint: Invitations expire after 60 seconds. No teleportation.
message.mchjong.invitation: %1$s invites you to a mahjong table at %2$s, %3$s, %4$s (%5$s). Approach within 6 blocks and accept within 60 seconds.
message.mchjong.invite_unavailable: This invitation cannot be used. Check the lobby, free seats and player status.
message.mchjong.invite_expired: This invitation has expired or is no longer valid.
message.mchjong.invite_approach: Approach within 6 blocks of the invited table, then click Accept again.
message.mchjong.invite_joined: %s accepted the invitation and joined the table.
message.mchjong.host_lobby: Only the host can change this setting, before the match starts.
message.mchjong.seat_required: Sit at a mahjong table to use this command.
message.mchjong.missing_stool: Place a stool on this side to sit down. Crouch-click the table to spectate.
ui.mchjong.confirm_hint: Enter confirms the selected tile. Right-click or Esc cancels selection.
ui.mchjong.choose_riichi: Select a legal riichi discard, then confirm
ui.mchjong.spectator_help: Spectating · Esc Close · Click a stool to join
ui.mchjong.help_single_click: Click Discard · Shift-click Select · R Riichi · P Pass · Home Center · Right-drag Look
ui.mchjong.help_double_click: Double-click Discard · ←/→ Select · Enter Confirm · R Riichi · P Pass · Right-drag Look
ui.mchjong.help_confirm: Click/←/→ Select · Enter Confirm · R Riichi · P Pass · Home Center · Right-drag Look
ui.mchjong.title: Mahjong table
ui.mchjong.settlement_note: Before settlement → after settlement. Changes include honba and awarded deposits.
ui.mchjong.pan: Right-drag to look around · Esc to close
ui.mchjong.help: Select a tile, then choose an action on its callout
ui.mchjong.help_direct: Click a legal tile to discard · Right-drag to look around · Esc to close
settings.mchjong.title: Table display settings
settings.mchjong.save_failed: Could not save MCjhong client settings
message.mchjong.space: The table requires a clear 3 × 3 area with solid ground beneath its center.
message.mchjong.no_table: Place the stool two blocks north, south, east or west of the table's center.
message.mchjong.occupied: This seat is occupied or reserved for another player.
message.mchjong.inactive_seat: This side is not used in three-player mahjong.
message.mchjong.already_seated: You already have a seat at this table.
message.mchjong.corrupt: This table's saved game could not be loaded. See the server log; the save has not been replaced.
message.mchjong.stale: The table has changed. Choose an action again.
action.mchjong.practice: Fill empty seats with training opponents
